title: A Weekend to Remember
subtitle: Example sheet with every task type
subject: Englisch

tasks.title: Mia's Saturday
tasks.text:
Last Saturday Mia woke up early.
She walked to the park with her dog Toby.
Suddenly Toby saw a cat and ran away.
Mia looked everywhere, but she didn't find him.
In the evening Toby came home on his own.

options.fb: Mia looked for someone. Read line 3 again.
The cat was there, but who ran? Line 3.

tasks.title: Regular verbs
tasks.prompt: Write the verbs in the past simple.
tasks.promptDe: Schreib die Verben im Past Simple.
tasks.text: Mia {{walked}} (walk) to the park. She {{looked}} (look) everywhere. They {{stopped}} (stop) at the gate.

feedback.stoped: With short verbs like *stop* you double the last letter: stop → stopped.

tasks.explain: Regular verbs get **-ed**. Short verbs like *stop* double the last letter.

tasks.title: Choose the form
tasks.text: Toby {{*ran|runned|run}} away. Mia {{*didn't find|didn't found|not found}} him.

2.didn't found: After *didn't* the verb stays in the base form: didn't **find**.

tasks.title: Contractions count too
tasks.text: Toby came home. → Toby {{didn't come|did not come}} home.

tasks.title: Irregular verbs
tasks.prompt: Match the verbs to their past forms.
tasks.promptDe: Ordne die Verben ihren Vergangenheitsformen zu.

tasks.title: Which sentences are in the past?
Put the story in order
tasks.prompt: Move the parts into the right order.
tasks.promptDe: Bring die Teile in die richtige Reihenfolge.
items: She walked to the park with Toby.
Toby saw a cat and ran away.
In the evening Toby came home.

tasks.title: Find the past forms
tasks.prompt: Tap all verbs in the past simple.
tasks.promptDe: Tippe alle Verben im Past Simple an.
tasks.text: Yesterday Ben [missed] the bus. He [ran] to school and [was] late. His teacher is nice.

tasks.title: Your story
tasks.prompt: Write a short story about a day when something went wrong.
tasks.promptDe: Schreib eine kurze Geschichte über einen Tag, an dem etwas schiefging.
checklist: My story is in the past simple.
It has a beginning, a middle and an end.
checklistDe: Meine Geschichte steht im Past Simple.
Sie hat einen Anfang, einen Mittelteil und einen Schluss.
